specification.primary: Paired fresh-data NLL gain of combined confidence-gated delayed residual memory versus same calibrated FREM checkpoint with memory off; threshold remains 0.01 nat. Secondary comparisons cannot replace a failed primary.
specification.freshness: New stock histories not found in local study metadata. Pre2025 only. Known economic dates and survivor selection prevent independent-confirmatory claims. No completed outputs used for selection.
specification.training: Outer train split 50/15/15/20 by dates with strict maturity purge: base fitting, checkpoint selection, shared distribution calibration, residual/key-metric fitting. Outer validation only chooses memory gate and risk multiplier. Base never refit after residuals.
specification.base: FREM standardized head; 12 epochs max, batch32, patience3, CPU single-thread. no_jepa control same. Ridge/XGBoost same earlier training partition, shared later calibration. Zero and historical-mean controls.
specification.calibration: Common NLL grid: mean shrink alpha[0,.5,1] toward zero, scale[.5,.75,1,1.5,2]; ties smaller alpha then scale nearer1. Preserve raw base forecasts for calibration comparison.
specification.memory: Versioned normalized residual z=(y-mu)/scale; fixed base/scaler/key versions. Only strictly matured labels enter. capacity128, neighbors4; separately balanced same-capacity, larger512, dual recent/archive, cross-asset standardized, learned diagonal/key projection, frozen, random age-matched and recent-average controls.
specification.keys: Fixed current keys plus separately declared learned ridge projection of simple raw causal descriptors to normalized residual and squared residual; fit only residual training partition, freeze thereafter.
specification.gate: Weights[0,.25,.5,1] and risk powers[0,.5,1] on validation NLL; mean-only/risk-only/combined separate. Confidence effective neighbor count/4 times inverse residual disagreement times absolute-age decay exp(-ln2*weighted_age/180), clipped[0,1]. Utilities based on matured deployed NLL differences, bounded; utility retention optional separate arm.
specification.risk: Scale factor from weighted second normalized residual moment divided by Student-t variance df/(df-2), with four pseudo-observations at unit factor; bounded [.5,2].
specification.synthetic: Predeclared null, recurring mean, recurring variance, abrupt change, and missing/delayed families; 3 independent path seeds 101,211,307; 4 assets; 420 times. 180 initial episodes, 100 validation, remainder eval. Oracle distribution saved only as diagnostic. Not market evidence.
specification.stages: A integrity; C mechanism matrix. If recurrence benefit or null nonharm fails, mark mechanism gate failed and do not run market promotion. No code/parameter retuning based on synthetic or market outcomes. Engineering defects may be repaired with a new receipt.
specification.mechanism_gate: All families finite and complete; combined NLL gain vs off positive on mean-recurrence average; null combined minus off NLL <=0.01 averaged across fixed seeds. No significance claim.
specification.statistics: Equal date/asset weighting, average seeds per paired date. Per-fold 3-month circular blocks, 2000 repetitions seed1901, 95% interval; 6-month sensitivity also always reported. Holm secondary family. Short windows force exploratory interpretation; no invented independent replicates.
specification.protected_boundary: 2025-01-01 unchanged; no protected acquisition or evaluation
specification.later_stages: Confirmation blocked pending unseen admitted data/protocol; portfolio claims blocked pending executable price/action/FX/eligibility data. Implement local hypothetical research ledger only with explicit limitations.
specification.stopping: No result-driven retries, omitted seeds, favorable-fold selection or post-hoc threshold changes.

scope: Execution freeze before any generated/new public outcomes; canonical protected freeze untouched
